cards.title: Model Qualification and Diagnostic Criteria
cards.claim: Model qualification relies on visual predictive checks (VPC), goodness-of-fit plots (observed vs. predicted), and residual diagnostics (e.g., CWRES). For nested models, a decrease in the objective function (reported as -1*log likelihood in S-ADAPT) of 1.92 U (chi-square test, 1 df) was considered significant in the source study. The source study tested suspected outliers and excluded observations using its weighted-residual and fitted-function criteria. For a new analysis, prespecify and justify outlier handling, document exclusions, and assess their influence by refitting the final model to the complete dataset; residual anomalies may reflect model misspecification. Model performance must be evaluated for misspecification relative to the intended objective.
limitations: Visual inspection is subjective without quantitative thresholds
Outlier exclusion criteria must be predefined

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
